---
name: webgl-3d-creative
description: Plan and implement optional WebGL, Three.js, 3D scenes, shaders, and immersive web visuals responsibly.
---
# WebGL and 3D
- Use 3D only when it improves comprehension or product value; keep dashboards data-first.
- Check bundle impact and existing dependencies before adding Three.js or shader tooling.
- Provide a graceful fallback for unsupported devices, reduced motion, and low-power hardware.
- Optimize geometry, textures, draw calls, resolution, and resource disposal.
- Avoid blocking initial content; lazy-load nonessential 3D scenes.
- Keep controls accessible and provide non-3D equivalents for essential information.
